name: RAT
_comment: Insert effect: a ProCo RAT modelled from its circuit (rat_core.h). "effect": true makes gen_vst.py list it as an insert effect (as in mpc-vst-faderfx). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is rat_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
